title: Portfolio v2
description: Designing and building a tactile, high-craft developer & designer portfolio with interactive 3D elements.

sections.label: Overview
sections.heading: Creating a portfolio that feels alive
body: I wanted Portfolio v2 to feel like a real living space, not just another static list of links and project grids. When someone visits, I want them to actually feel the interface react to them as they move around, view case studies, check out the archive, or open up the resume sheet.

Instead of writing down a rigid plan up front, I worked directly with Antigravity to build and tweak things iteratively right inside the code. We tried out ideas in real time, testing out animations, cursor behaviors, and layout tweaks as we went along so the design system naturally grew out of what felt right while using it.

sections.label: Process
sections.heading: Spotting what was missing and tuning the system
body: We started by getting the core pieces running fast: basic custom cursor states, the header navigation, ambient backgrounds, and main project cards. But once I spent some time testing it out on different screen sizes, a few things stood out.

The desktop layout looked great, but on smaller phones around 375px, things like the header and overlay drawers started crowding the viewport or getting clipped, so we needed a proper mobile setup. Visuals alone also weren't enough—adding subtle audio clicks and custom cursor states when hovering over buttons or project cards made the site feel way more responsive and fun to interact with.
bullets: Rebuilt the navigation header with glassmorphic blur effects, smooth transition links, and clean dark/light mode toggles.
Added an interactive 3D blob canvas and dynamic section badges so the page has a distinct visual character.
Built a custom cursor that changes how it looks and behaves depending on whether you're hovering over text, external links, media, or action buttons.
Created smooth slide-over sheets for project deep dives, the archive gallery, and the resume so visitors don't lose their scroll position.

sections.label: Result
sections.heading: A tactile, high-craft interactive portfolio
body: The result is a single-page interactive portfolio that combines software engineering precision with expressive visual identity. Navigating between selected work, detailed case studies, an interactive archive, and an immersive resume view feels seamless and responsive across all devices.
bullets: Context-aware custom cursor with smooth state transitions across interactive elements.
Tactile micro-sound feedback integrated with UI hover and click interactions.
Modular drawer and modal sheets for seamless deep-dive reading experience.

sections.label: Reflection
sections.heading: Iterative pair-building with AI
body: Building this iteratively with Antigravity made it so much easier to take rough ideas and turn them into finished React components fast. Being able to test micro-interactions, adjust spacing, and see how things felt in real time helped me build a portfolio that actually matches how I like to design and build things.

Because everything is broken down into clean reusable pieces (theme context, audio providers, shared UI components, and modal drawers), it's going to be really easy to keep adding new case studies and experiments down the road.
